An analysis plan for mv_ask()

Source: R/ask-plan.R
mv_plan.Rd

A plan lists, in a structured form, what the generated script should do: which columns are items, which model to fit, which group to test for DIF and which outputs to produce. mv_ask() fills a plan from a plain-language request, but a plan can also be written by hand and passed to mv_ask(plan = ), or changed with update_plan().

Usage

mv_plan(
  items = NULL,
  model = "auto",
  nfact = 1,
  group = NULL,
  missing = NULL,
  key = NULL,
  rt = NULL,
  steps = c("describe", "fitcheck", "interpret"),
  options = list(),
  assumptions = character()
)

update_plan(plan, ...)

Arguments

items

item columns: a character vector of names, a range such as "Q1:Q20", or NULL for all columns that look like items.

model

"auto" (compare models with select_model()), "Rasch", "2PL", "3PL", "graded" or "gpcm".

nfact

number of latent dimensions (1 to 3).

group

name of a grouping column (e.g. "gender") for a DIF analysis. Setting it adds the "dif" step.

missing

numeric codes that mean "missing", e.g. c(9, 99).

key

answer key for multiple-choice items that are not yet scored.

rt

response-time columns, one per item and in the same order. Setting it adds the "rt" step.

steps

the analysis steps, any of "describe", "fitcheck", "dif", "scores", "plots", "interpret", "cards", "report" and "rt". A model is always fitted.

options

per-step options as a named list of lists, e.g. list(scores = list(method = "MAP", file = "scores.csv"), report = list(file = "report.html"), fit = list(criterion = "AIC")).

assumptions

notes about how the request was understood; they are printed with the plan and written as comments in the script.

plan

an mv_plan object.

...

fields to change, as in mv_plan().

Value

An object of class mv_plan.

Examples

mv_plan(model = "2PL", group = "gender", steps = c("fitcheck", "report"))
#> Analysis plan
#>   - Items: all columns that look like items 
#>   - Model: 2PL, 1 dimension 
#>   - DIF by: gender 
#>   - Steps: fit, fitcheck, dif, report
